/* cppi::7590cf6d0432c3afc98f556fca9c40df74c50afa684c3f38bbee1f9c4497afb3 */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-02')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-02')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance_uat.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-02')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Acronyms:
-- - ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
-- - CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
-- - CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
-- - NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
-- - HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Data Lineage Summary:
-- - Holdings Source:       holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
--                          (CI Sentry - current holdings data)
-- - Security Metadata:     reference.ci_sentry_security
--                          (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
-- - Coupon Metadata:       reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--                          (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Parameters:
-- - business_date     : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_holdings.
-- - asset_type filter : Hardcoded list of included asset types.
-- - seniority filter  : Hardcoded list of included seniorities.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata, includes
--   filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest business date.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.1.0 | 2025-04-28 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Corrected filtering - moved the schedules to a CTE. The join and where conditions
--   were causing incorrect result set.
-- - Added the injections for the full table names to allow different environments
-- - Removed reference to ci_sentry_commtiments - funded_amount will come from ci_sentry_holdings.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.2.0 | 2025-05-21 | gstoffer@cppig.com
-- - Updated query to align with new holdings_staging schema
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WITH

max_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(business_date) AS max_business_date
    FROM holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
),

included_asset_types AS (
    SELECT 'Auto ABS'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Bond'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CMBS'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Construction Loan'  AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Convertible Bond'   AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Delayed Draw'       AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'External Debt'      AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'HRR Bond'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Loan'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'NPL'                AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Other ABS'          AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Revolver'           AS asset_type
),

included_seniority AS (
    SELECT '1st Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT '2nd Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'ABS Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'B-Note'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'First Mortgage'     AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Hold Co/Pref'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Jr Sub'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Junior Mezzanine'   AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Mezzanine'          AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'RE Mezz'            AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Secured'         AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Subordinated'    AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Unsecured'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Unitranche'         AS seniority
),

included_security_type AS (
    SELECT 'convertible'             AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'debt'                    AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'delayedDrawLoanFacility' AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'revolvingCreditFacility' AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'termLoanFacility'        AS sentry_security_type
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT  -- Removes multiple loan contract records
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-11' AS DATE)
),

schedule_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_schedules
    WHERE schedule_name = 'Debt_Factor'

select a.*, b.*, c.*, d.*, e.*, a1.*,up.*
from (select id_instrument,
             instrument_id_type,
             id_instrument_alternate,
             instrument_alternate_id_type,
             instrument_family_name_source,
             instrument_group_name_source,
             instrument_type_name_source,
             instrument_type,
             instrument_sub_type,
             swap_underlying_type,
             trade_ref_id,
             id_counterparty,
             counterparty_id_type,
             id_counterparty_source,
             counterparty_source_id_type,
             trading_portfolio_code,
             custody_account_code,
             market_value,
             market_value_currency,
             current_price,
             fx_rate_base_currency,
             fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
             fx_rate_quoted_in_usd,
             trade_id,
             current_contract_id,
             trade_date,
             trade_status,
             deal_type,
             final_payment_date,
             effective_date,
             maturity_date,
             last_corporate_event_date,
             trade_strategy_name,
             trade_comment_text,
             future_cash_flows,
             future_cash_flows_currency,
             original_notional_value,
             original_notional_value                         as current_nominal,
             original_notional_value * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad as current_nominal_pc,
             market_value                                    as clean_market_value,
             market_value * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad            as clean_market_value_pc,
             market_value                                    as market_value_mv,
             market_value * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad            as market_value_base_mv,
             original_notional_currency,
             original_notional_currency as current_notional_currency,
             fixed_leg_leg_type,
             fixed_leg_day_count_convention,
             fixed_leg_original_currency,
             fixed_leg_current_effective_date,
             dividend_strike_price,
             fixed_leg_value,
             fixed_leg_value_currency,
             dividend_leg_leg_type,
             underlying_instrument_name,
             id_underlying_instrument,
             underlying_instrument_id_type,
             id_underlying_instrument_source,
             underlying_instrument_source_id_type,
             dividend_leg_original_currency,
             dividend_leg_effective_date,
             dividend_leg_current_fixing_rate,
             dividend_leg_day_count_convention,
             dividend_leg_value,
             dividend_leg_value_currency,
             original_quantity,
             current_quantity
      from trades_deals.dswp_trades
      where business_date = date '2025-06-11'
     ) as a
         left join
     (select trading_portfolio_code, id_model_portfolio
      from finance_accounting.murex_scd_model_portfolios_mapping
      where business_date = date '2025-06-11'
     ) as b
     on a.trading_portfolio_code = b.trading_portfolio_code
         left join
     (select id_model_portfolio, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
      from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
      where business_date = date '2025-06-11'
     ) as c
     on b.id_model_portfolio = c.id_model_portfolio
         left join
     (select cppib_party_id,
           party_name,
           domicile_country_code,
           incorp_country_code,
           bloomberg_company_id
      from party.party
      where business_date = date '2025-06-11'
     ) as d
     on d.cppib_party_id = cast(a.id_counterparty as int)
         left Join
     (select cppib_sec_id,
             cppib_party_id as underlying_cppib_party_id,
             instrument_name,
             type,
             sub_type,
             shares_outstanding_real,
             par_amount,
             ticker,
             region_code,
             market_sector_description,
             country_code,
             currency_code,
             sedol,
             isin,
             cusip,
             exchange_name,
             mic,
             delete_date,
             bloomberg_exchange,
             bloomberg_unique_id,
             bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange,
             callable_flag,
             putable_flag,
             convertible_flag
      FROM asset.asset_equity equity
      where business_date = date '2025-06-11'
     ) as e
     on e.cppib_sec_id = cast(a.id_underlying_instrument as int)
     left join
    (
        select cppib_party_id as u_cppib_party_id,
           party_name as u_party_name,
           domicile_country_code as u_domicile_country_code,
           incorp_country_code as u_incorp_country_code,
           bloomberg_company_id as u_bloomberg_company_id
        from party.party
        where business_date = date '2025-06-11'
    ) as up
        on e.underlying_cppib_party_id = up.u_cppib_party_id
         left join
     (select cppib_currency_of_exposure_code,
             cppib_sec_id as cppib_sec_id_new2
      from asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
      where business_date = date '2025-06-11'
     ) as a1
     on a1.cppib_sec_id_new2 = cast(a.id_underlying_instrument as int)

/* cppi::b0024cbbc3fec00fc535b127bea8e6328626ea799768349f3d53858d1cf38fbb */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 09 and 10
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 09:06:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 21 and 22
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 21:18:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT "business_date", "abor_transaction_number", "abor_security_id", "sedol", "isin", "cusip", "esm_incorp_country_code", "security_name_id", "sst_custody_account_code", "model_portfolio_id", "business_transaction_code", "settlement_currency", "trade_date", "payment_date", "nominal", "nominal_basis", "elementary_transaction_code", "interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency", "interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency", "transaction_cancellation_flag", "reconciliation_status", "created_date", "party_id", "epm_party_name", "transaction_number_in_originating_system", "payment_amount_quotation_currency", "payment_amount_portfolio_currency", "external_short_tag", "settlement_date", "quotation_currency", "number_of_units", "cross_deal_indicator", "settlement_location", "esm_country_code", "country_ref_code", "esm_country_name", "esm_incorp_country_name", "portfolio_group_id", "abor_security_group_name", "abor_security_type_name", "model_portfolio_name", "country_ref_name", "quotation_currency_name", "price_qc", "price_pc", "fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency", "cppib_country_of_exposure_name", "cppib_currency_of_exposure_name", "portfolio_name", "portfolio_group_name", "investment_strategy_name", "investment_department_name", "abor_instrument_type_id", "investment_type_name", "investmentstructurelevel3", "investmentstructurelevel4", "abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency", "other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency", "abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency", "other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency", "portfolio_id", "ibor_reason", "abor_coupon_rate", "dividend_per_share", "borrowing_account", "coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency", "coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency", "coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency", "restitution_expected_portfolio_currency", "restitution_expected_quotation_currency", "restitution_expected_settlement_currency", "accrued_interest_portfolio_currency", "accrued_interest_quotation_currency", "current_value_portfolio_currency", "current_value_quotation_currency", "additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency", "additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency"
FROM (WITH RankedTransactions AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY model_portfolio_id, 
		                	abor_security_number, 
		                	abor_transaction_number,
		                	scd_transaction_number_primary_key, -- same transaction number can have different primary key
		                	elementary_transaction_code
						order by
							changed_date desc -- change date is actual loaded date so use this to get the latest data.
           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        st.scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
        CAST(st.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,
        ROUND(st.abor_transaction_number) AS abor_transaction_number,
        st.abor_security_id,
        st.abor_security_number,
        st.abor_security_name,
        st.model_portfolio_id,
        st.portfolio_id,
        st.business_transaction_code,
        st.settlement_currency,
        CAST(st.trade_date AS DATE) AS trade_date,
        CAST(st.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date,
        st.nominal,
        st.nominal_basis,
        st.elementary_transaction_code,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
        st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
        st.reconciliation_status,
        CAST(CAST(st.created_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS created_date,
        st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
        st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.external_short_tag,
        CAST(st.settlement_date AS DATE) AS settlement_date,
        st.settlement_location,
        st.quotation_currency,
        st.number_of_units,
        st.price AS price_qc,
        st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS price_pc,
        st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
        st.current_value_portfolio_currency,
        st.current_value_quotation_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'
        END AS cross_deal_indicator,
        -- From joins
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,
        es.security_name_id,
        es.esm_country_code,
        es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
        es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
        smp.sst_custody_account_code,
        smp.model_portfolio_name,
        smp.investment_strategy_name,
        smp.investment_department_name,
        ep.party_id,
        ep.epm_party_name,
        ss.abor_security_group_name,
        ss.abor_security_type_name,
        ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
        ss.investment_type_name,
        ss.abor_coupon_rate,
        rec.country_ref_code,
        rcc_exchange_country.country_name AS esm_country_name,
        rcc_incorp_country.country_name AS esm_incorp_country_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_id,
        sp.portfolio_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_name,
        rcc_trade_country.country_name AS country_ref_name,
        rcc.currency_name AS quotation_currency_name,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel4
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn

    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country

    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'

        AND spif.rn = 1

AND transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active') AS "transactions_base"

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 13 and 14
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 13:13:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY

-- Query # 19 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,

-- Query # 19 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

-- Query # 19 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

-- Query # 19 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

-- Query # 22 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c ON b.business_date = c.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = c.cppib_sec_id

        ( i.ticker = 'NXPI' AND ( e.equity_exchange_code = 'US' OR w.equity_exchange_code = 'US' ) )

-- Query # 22 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 22 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,

		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Acronyms:
-- - ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
-- - CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
-- - CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
-- - NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
-- - HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Data Lineage Summary:
-- - Holdings Source:       holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
--                          (CI Sentry - current holdings data)
-- - Security Metadata:     reference.ci_sentry_security
--                          (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
-- - Coupon Metadata:       reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--                          (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Parameters:
-- - business_date     : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_holdings.
-- - asset_type filter : Hardcoded list of included asset types.
-- - seniority filter  : Hardcoded list of included seniorities.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata, includes
--   filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest business date.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.1.0 | 2025-04-28 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Corrected filtering - moved the schedules to a CTE. The join and where conditions
--   were causing incorrect result set.
-- - Added the injections for the full table names to allow different environments
-- - Removed reference to ci_sentry_commtiments - funded_amount will come from ci_sentry_holdings.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.2.0 | 2025-05-21 | gstoffer@cppig.com
-- - Updated query to align with new holdings_staging schema
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WITH

max_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(business_date) AS max_business_date
    FROM holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
),

included_asset_types AS (
    SELECT 'Auto ABS'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Bond'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CMBS'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Construction Loan'  AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Convertible Bond'   AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Delayed Draw'       AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'External Debt'      AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'HRR Bond'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Loan'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'NPL'                AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Other ABS'          AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Revolver'           AS asset_type
),

included_seniority AS (
    SELECT '1st Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT '2nd Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'ABS Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'B-Note'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'First Mortgage'     AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Hold Co/Pref'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Jr Sub'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Junior Mezzanine'   AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Mezzanine'          AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'RE Mezz'            AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Secured'         AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Subordinated'    AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Unsecured'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Unitranche'         AS seniority
),

included_security_type AS (
    SELECT 'convertible'             AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'debt'                    AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'delayedDrawLoanFacility' AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'revolvingCreditFacility' AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'termLoanFacility'        AS sentry_security_type
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT  -- Removes multiple loan contract records
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-11' AS DATE)
),

schedule_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_schedules
    WHERE schedule_name = 'Debt_Factor'
      AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-11' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-11' AS DATE)
          BETWEEN CAST(start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(end_date AS DATE)
)

    HOLD.business_date                                   AS business_date,
    '5f1c3497-f8da-4a0c-bc54-fa614f77362a'                                           AS run_id,

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Acronyms:
-- - ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
-- - CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
-- - CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
-- - NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
-- - HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Data Lineage Summary:
-- - Holdings Source:       holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
--                          (CI Sentry - current holdings data)
-- - Security Metadata:     reference.ci_sentry_security
--                          (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
-- - Coupon Metadata:       reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--                          (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Parameters:
-- - business_date     : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_holdings.
-- - asset_type filter : Hardcoded list of included asset types.
-- - seniority filter  : Hardcoded list of included seniorities.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata, includes
--   filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest business date.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.1.0 | 2025-04-28 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Corrected filtering - moved the schedules to a CTE. The join and where conditions
--   were causing incorrect result set.
-- - Added the injections for the full table names to allow different environments
-- - Removed reference to ci_sentry_commtiments - funded_amount will come from ci_sentry_holdings.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.2.0 | 2025-05-21 | gstoffer@cppig.com
-- - Updated query to align with new holdings_staging schema
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WITH

max_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(business_date) AS max_business_date
    FROM holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
),

included_asset_types AS (
    SELECT 'Auto ABS'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Bond'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CMBS'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Construction Loan'  AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Convertible Bond'   AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Delayed Draw'       AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'External Debt'      AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'HRR Bond'           AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Loan'               AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'NPL'                AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Other ABS'          AS asset_type UNION
    SELECT 'Revolver'           AS asset_type
),

included_seniority AS (
    SELECT '1st Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT '2nd Lien'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'ABS Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'B-Note'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'CLO Debt'           AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'First Mortgage'     AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Hold Co/Pref'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Jr Sub'             AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Junior Mezzanine'   AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Mezzanine'          AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'RE Mezz'            AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Secured'         AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Subordinated'    AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Sr Unsecured'       AS seniority UNION
    SELECT 'Unitranche'         AS seniority
),

included_security_type AS (
    SELECT 'convertible'             AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'debt'                    AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'delayedDrawLoanFacility' AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'revolvingCreditFacility' AS sentry_security_type UNION
    SELECT 'termLoanFacility'        AS sentry_security_type
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT  -- Removes multiple loan contract records
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-11' AS DATE)
),

schedule_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_schedules
    WHERE schedule_name = 'Debt_Factor'
      AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-11' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-11' AS DATE)
          BETWEEN CAST(start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(end_date AS DATE)
)

    SEC.quantity_multiplier                              AS quantity_multiplier,
    NULL                                                  AS debt_factor,
    HOLD.model_portfolio_id                              AS model_portfolio_id,
    NULL                                                  AS ticket_number,
    NULL                                                  AS probability_of_close,
    NULL                                                  AS binding,
    NULL                                                  AS capital_usage_component,
    'Capital Call/Distribution'                          AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
    NULL                                                  AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
    NULL                                                  AS expected_funding_date,
    NULL                                                  AS expected_trade_date,
    SEC.expected_exit_price                              AS expected_exit_price,
    SEC.expected_exit_probability                        AS expected_exit_probability,
    SEC.expected_exit_date                               AS expected_exit_date,
    NULL                                                  AS expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
    NULL                                                 AS unadjusted_exit_projection,
    NULL                                                  AS last_updated_by,
    NULL                                                  AS last_updated_date,
    NULL                                                  AS created_by_user_group,
    NULL                                                  AS created_by,
    NULL                                                  AS date_updated,
    HOLD.business_date                                   AS holdings_src_business_date,
    SEC.business_date                                    AS security_src_business_date,
    ACCT.business_date                                   AS account_src_business_date,
    SCHED.business_date                                  AS schedule_src_business_date,
    COUP.business_date                                   AS coupon_src_business_date,
    NULL                                                 AS comment,
    NULL                                                 AS error,
    NULL                                                 AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
    NULL                                                 AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
    NULL                                                 AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
    NULL                                                 AS fo_comments,
    NULL                                                 AS pec_recusals,
    NULL                                                 AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
    NULL                                                 AS fx_spot,
    NULL                                                 AS full_amt_cad_mm,
    NULL                                                 AS rejected_deals_reason,
    NULL                                                 AS investment_program,
    NULL                                                 AS investment_strategy,
    NULL                                                 AS investment_group,
    NULL                                                 AS tfm_inv_sub_strategy,
    'holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings, reference_dev.ci_sentry_security, reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon, reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_schedules, reference_dev.ci_sentry_account'
                                                         AS data_sources_list

FROM holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings AS HOLD

LEFT JOIN reference_dev.ci_sentry_security AS SEC
  ON HOLD.security_identifier = SEC.security_identifier

INNER JOIN included_asset_types AS ASS_TYPE
  ON SEC.asset_type = ASS_TYPE.asset_type

INNER JOIN included_seniority AS SEN_TYPE
  ON SEC.seniority = SEN_TYPE.seniority

INNER JOIN included_security_type AS SENTRY_TYPE
  ON HOLD.sentry_security_type = SENTRY_TYPE.sentry_security_type

LEFT JOIN coupon_list AS COUP
  ON SEC.security_identifier = COUP.security_identifier

LEFT JOIN reference_dev.ci_sentry_account AS ACCT
  ON HOLD.account_id = ACCT.account_id

LEFT JOIN schedule_list AS SCHED
  ON HOLD.security_identifier = SCHED.security_identifier

WHERE CAST(HOLD.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-11' AS DATE)
  AND CAST('2025-06-11' AS DATE)
      BETWEEN CAST(SEC.start_date  AS DATE) AND CAST(SEC.end_date   AS DATE)
  AND CAST('2025-06-11' AS DATE)
      BETWEEN CAST(ACCT.start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(ACCT.end_date  AS DATE)

WITH

  LATEST_BUSINESS_DATE AS
  (SELECT MAX(source_business_date) AS bdate, MAX(chron_id) AS chron_id
  FROM risk_prod.dim_chron C WHERE C.CANONICAL_SOURCE='1'
  AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM risk_prod.DIM_CR_EXP_LEGAL_ENTITY LE	WHERE C.CHRON_ID = LE.CHRON_ID )),

  SINGLE_BUSINESS_DATE AS
  (SELECT source_business_date AS bdate, chron_id AS chron_id
  FROM risk_prod.dim_chron C WHERE source_business_date= date'2025-06-11' and C.CANONICAL_SOURCE='1'
  AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM risk_prod.DIM_CR_EXP_LEGAL_ENTITY LE	WHERE C.CHRON_ID = LE.CHRON_ID )),

  BUSINESS_DATE AS
  (SELECT * FROM SINGLE_BUSINESS_DATE), -- Select your date here

  IP_PV AS
  (SELECT FACT.analytic_value AS pv
  FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
      risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact,
      risk_prod.dim_chron c,
      risk_prod.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE node
	 WHERE
	  FACT.CHRON_ID = c.CHRON_ID
    AND c.chron_ID = bd.chron_id
	  AND fact.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = node.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
	  AND fact.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
	  AND FACT.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'IP'
	  AND node.node_level = 1),

  ACPP_PV AS
  ( SELECT
      f.analytic_value AS pv
    FROM
      BUSINESS_DATE bd,
      risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD f
      JOIN risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account h
        on f.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = h.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
    WHERE
      f.CHRON_ID = bd.CHRON_ID
      AND f.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
      AND f.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
      AND h.ACCOUNT='ACPP'
      AND h.node_level = 2),

  BCPP_PV AS
  ( SELECT
      f.analytic_value AS pv
    FROM
      BUSINESS_DATE bd,
      risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD f
      JOIN risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account h
        on f.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = h.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
    WHERE
      f.CHRON_ID = bd.CHRON_ID
      AND f.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
      AND f.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
      AND h.ACCOUNT='BCPP'
      AND h.node_level = 2),

  CE_LE AS (
	  SELECT
		PARENT.party_name,
		sum( coalesce(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) AS credit_exposure,
		sum( coalesce(FACT.ACPP_credit_exposure, 0) ) AS ACPP_credit_exposure,
		sum( coalesce(FACT.BCPP_credit_exposure, 0) ) AS BCPP_credit_exposure,
    MAX(PARENT.gics_sector) AS SECTOR,
    MAX(regexp_extract(PARENT.rtg_final, '^[A-D]{1,3}')) AS RATING
	  FROM
    BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity CHILD,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity PARENT,
    IP_PV pv

		fact.chron_id = bd.chron_id
		AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id

		AND NOT ( (PARENT.is_government = 'Y' OR PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y') AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA') )
	  GROUP BY PARENT.party_name),

  CE_LE_CN AS (
	  SELECT
		sum( coalesce(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) AS credit_exposure,

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 22 and 23
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 22:53:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 00 and 01

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 00:46:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

/* cppi::71dab1ff5860710173676edc5c8004f54cf41892c4a4a0116319c90a62935887 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 16 and 17
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 16:21:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 09 and 10
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 09:16:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 19 and 20
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 19:13:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

select 
var.benchmark_name,
var.hierarchy_type,
var.hierarchy_node,
CAST(var.var95 AS decimal(22,6)) as var95,
CAST(b.mean AS decimal(22,6)) as mean,
CAST(c.vol AS decimal(22,6)) as vol,
CAST(d.cs01 AS decimal(22,6)) as cs01,
CAST(e.dv01 AS decimal(22,6)) as dv01,
CAST(f.pv AS decimal(22,6)) as pv
from (
select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "var95", run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_var
where business_date = '2025-05-30' 
and benchmark_name = 'SAP SUPP' and hierarchy_type = 'sa_supp'
and analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' and percent_confidence_level = 95 and run_id = 'SAP_SUPP'
) as var
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_mean 
where business_date = '2025-05-30' and analytic_type = 'MEAN_10YR'
) as b on var.run_id = b.run_id and b.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name   
and b.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and b.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "vol", run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol 
where business_date = '2025-05-30' and analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR'
) as c on var.run_id = c.run_id and c.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and c.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and c.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join
(
select benchmark_name,  hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, sum(total) as cs01, run_id
from (
select *, reduce(cs01, 0 , (s, x) -> s + x, s -> s) AS total from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_cs01
where business_date = '2025-05-30' 
) group by benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, run_id
) as d on var.run_id = d.run_id and d.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and d.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and d.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join
(
select benchmark_name,  hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, sum(total) as dv01, run_id
from (
select *, reduce(dv01, 0 , (s, x) -> s + x, s -> s) AS total from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_dv01
where business_date = '2025-05-30'

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 14 and 15
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 14:56:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::12c933a9cbd14bba87adbf3d6e0ab3064dc14e834748d4db28b12454723653ae */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 05 and 06
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 05:41:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency
							WHERE ((erc.vendor = 'wm' AND erc.currency != 'CLF')
							        OR (erc.vendor = 'tokyo' AND erc.currency = 'CLF'))
								AND erc.currency IN ('USD','EUR','JPY','CHF','AUD','CNY','HKD','NZD','SEK','KRW','SGD','NOK','MXN','INR','DKK','CLF','IDR','CLP','BRL','CAD','MYR','COP','GBP','ARS','RON','RUB','PHP','ILS','PLN','PEN','LTL','LVL','SIT','SAR','ZAR','QAR','CZK','TWD','THB','PKR','TRY','ISK','KWD','AED','JOD','NGN','EGP','HUF','MAD','PGK','MOP','VES','VEF','LKR','BGN','VND','BMD','XOF','BDT','ZMW','KES','HRK','MWK','GHS','MUR','JMD','RSD','TND','KZT','UAH','TTD','OMR','TZS','BWP','UGX','BHD','ZWL','IRR','AZN','BYN','ZWG')

-- Query # 14 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 14 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined'

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 14 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined'

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 14 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined'

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id
